Training control

The real room warms up and cools down over hours. Here you set it yourself. Room 78°F

The thermostat calls when the room is 1°F or more above the setpoint. A second stage calls at 3°F or more.

What it sends to the unit

R24 V hot from the transformer
YR to Y closed: cooling call
Y2R to Y2 closed: stage 2 call
GR to G closed: indoor fan call
C24 V common return

A thermostat is only a set of switches. Change it here, then probe R, Y and G on the unit panel to see 24 V come and go.
